# Dune Browser Game

> A browser-based strategy game set in Frank Herbert's Dune universe — harvest spice, forge alliances, and rule Arrakis.

Built with React 18, TypeScript 5, and Vite. Runs entirely in the browser — no installation required.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Project overview, features, build instructions
- [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, branch naming, commit conventions
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): AI session instructions, architecture, coding conventions
- [SECURITY](SECURITY.md): Security policy and vulnerability reporting
- [Secrets Guide](docs/secrets-guide.md): CI/CD secrets setup — which tokens are auto-provided vs manually configured

## Automation

- [CI workflow](.github/workflows/ci.yml): Lint + type-check + build on every PR
- [Release workflow](.github/workflows/release.yml): Semver bump, build, GitHub Release
- [Pages deployment](.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml): Bilingual marketing site deploy
- [Container publish](.github/workflows/publish-container.yml): Docker image → GHCR

## Website

- [English site](website/index.html): Landing page (deployed to GitHub Pages)
- [Persian site](website/fa/index.html): Persian/RTL landing page
- [Stylesheet](website/styles.css): Shared Dune-themed CSS

## Infrastructure

- [Dockerfile](Dockerfile): Multi-stage build — Node 20 build → nginx serve
- [nginx config](nginx.conf): SPA routing + static asset caching
- [Hook installer](scripts/install-hooks.sh): Sets up pre-commit and commit-msg hooks
- [Repo setup](scripts/setup-repo.sh): Branch protection and merge strategy (run once)
- [version.txt](version.txt): Current semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH)
- [License](LICENSE): Apache License 2.0
